title: Barycentric Anchored Weight Search for Robust Model Merging
abstract: arXiv:2610.14017v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose Barycentric Anchored Search, a post-hoc weight-space procedure for improving fine-tuned vision models under distribution shift without additional gradient training or increased inference cost. Given a pre-trained initialization and two checkpoints fine-tuned on a source dataset, the method constructs barycentric candidate weights and performs a small derivative-free search along directions connecting each candidate to the pre-trained model. Candidate weights are selected using a small validation subset of one or more out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets; the selected model is then evaluated on the held-out portions of those datasets, on additional OOD benchmarks, and on the ImageNet validation set to quantify the robustness-accuracy trade-off. The method is inspired by simplex-based derivative-free optimization, including Nelder-Mead and Torczon multidirectional search, but is specialized to the geometry of neural network weig

translated_title: 用于鲁棒模型合并的重心锚定权重搜索
translated_abstract: 我们提出了重心锚定搜索，这是一种事后权重空间程序，用于在分布偏移下改进微调视觉模型，而无需额外的梯度训练或增加推理成本。给定一个预训练的初始化模型和在源数据集上微调的两个检查点，该方法构建重心候选权重，并沿着连接每个候选权重与预训练模型的方向进行小型无导数搜索。候选权重通过一个或多个分布外数据集的小型验证子集来选择；然后在所选数据集的保留部分、其他OOD基准测试以及ImageNet验证集上评估所选择的模型，以量化鲁棒性与准确性之间的权衡。该方法受到基于单纯形的无导数优化技术的启发，包括Nelder-Mead和Torczon多方向搜索，但专门针对神经网络权重的几何结构进行了特化（摘要文本在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种重心锚定搜索方法，通过沿重心候选权重方向的轻量级无导数搜索，在无需额外梯度训练或增加推理成本的情况下，提升微调视觉模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Barycentric Anchored Search, a lightweight derivative-free weight-space procedure that improves the robustness of fine-tuned vision models under distribution shift without additional gradient training or increased inference cost.
